summary:
Mert, a curious third-grade middle school student, is a boy with a great interest in space and whose biggest dream is to become an astronaut. Despite exam stress and difficulties, inspired by the Mars poster in his room, he never gives up; working day and night, he first enters a science high school and then successfully completes international space engineering training.
​When he is only 19 years old, he reaches Mars as Turkey's first astronaut to go to space. During his research on the Red Planet, he comes across an old NASA rover that broke down and was abandoned years ago. By melting and transforming these scrap parts using 3D printing technology, he builds an autonomous greenhouse and water purification unit. When Mert returns to Earth, he is welcomed with great pride both as a historic first Turkish astronaut and as a pioneering engineer laying the foundations of sustainable living in space with the idea of "space recycling," and through this, he takes a step toward a major invention on Earth.
details:
Project Summary: Mars Recycling Station

* What it does / How it works: The parts of old exploration vehicles left on the Martian surface (titanium and aluminum body panels) are dismantled and repurposed using 3D printing technology to build an autonomous agricultural and water purification system.

* Benefits: It reduces space debris and enables astronauts to be self-sufficient in space without depending on Earth.

* Creativity: It designs a sustainable living space by adopting the concept of "space recycling."
